reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_name,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_name,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
), numbered AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_name,
    SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT account_id, user_id, session_no, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'export_report') AS exports
  FROM numbered
  GROUP BY account_id, user_id, session_no
)
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exports > 0) / COUNT(*), 1) AS export_session_pct
FROM sessions
GROUP BY account_id

GROUP BY s.account_id

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM app_events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS sn FROM f),
ss AS (SELECT user_id, account_id, sn, MIN(event_ts) AS st, MAX(event_ts) AS en, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY user_id, account_id, sn), x AS (SELECT user_id, sn, bool_or(event_name = 'export_report') AS hit FROM s GROUP BY user_id, sn) SELECT ss.account_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE x.hit) / COUNT(*), 1) AS export_session_pct FROM ss JOIN x ON x.user_id = ss.user_id AND x.sn = ss.sn GROUP BY ss.account_id
